en.t: "It is so good to see you.

units.source_text: 柏木坐在石阶上，解开了包袱皮，

en.t: Kashiwagi sat down on the stone steps and untied the wrapping cloth,

units.source_text: 露出了两管散发着暗淡光泽的尺八荒，

en.t: revealing two rough shakuhachi blanks that gave off a dull sheen,

units.source_text: "前些日子，老家的伯父去世了，

en.t: "The other day, my uncle back home passed away,

units.source_text: 作为遗物，我要了这管尺八。

en.t: and I took this shakuhachi as a keepsake.
But I already have another one,

units.source_text: 是以前向伯父学习时伯父送给我的。

en.t: the one my uncle gave me when I was studying with him before.

units.source_text: 看起来，作为遗物的这管尺八是很名贵的。

en.t: From the look of it, this shakuhachi I received as a keepsake is quite valuable.

units.source_text: 但是，我还是喜欢我用惯了的。

en.t: But I still prefer the one I am used to playing.

units.source_text: 我有两管，没有多大用场，

en.t: There is not much use in my having two of them,

units.source_text: 我想送给你一管，也就把它带来了。"

en.t: so I thought I would give one to you, and that is why I brought it."
